preconditions.description: The number of tasks q is an integer between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.split()[0] == '1')
preconditions.description: For type 1 tasks, u_i is an integer between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x_i) <= 10**5 and 1 <= int(k_i) <= 10**5 and 1 <= int(s_i) <= 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.split()[0] == '2' for x_i, k_i, s_i in [line.split()[1:4]])
preconditions.description: For type 2 tasks, x_i, k_i, and s_i are integers between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The first task is always of type 1.
There is at least one task of type 2.

postconditions.expression: all((line.split()[0] == '1' or (line.split()[0] == '2' and (stdout_line := stdout.splitlines()[i].strip()) in ['-1'] or (v := int(stdout_line), any(v == int(num) for num in a) and (x_i := int(line.split()[1]), k_i := int(line.split()[2]), s_i := int(line.split()[3])) and k_i % math.gcd(x_i, v) == 0 and x_i + v <= s_i and all((x_i + v_alt <= s_i and k_i % math.gcd(x_i, v_alt) == 0) implies ((x_i ^ v) >= (x_i ^ v_alt)) for v_alt in a)))) for i, line in enumerate(stdin.splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: For each type 2 task, the output v (or -1) satisfies: (1) v is in the current array a, (2) k_i divides GCD(x_i, v), (3) x_i + v ≤ s_i, and (4) x_i XOR v is maximized among all valid v in a. If no such v exists, output -1.

postconditions.expression: all(line.split()[0] == '1' or (line.split()[0] == '2' and (stdout_line := stdout.splitlines()[i].strip()) == '-1' or (v := int(stdout_line), any(v == int(num) for num in a)))) for i, line in enumerate(stdin.splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: For each type 2 task, if the output is not -1, it must be an existing element in the current array a.
